items.headline: New twist in Sallay Easter attacks case
items.summary: At the Fort Magistrate's Court, the Additional Solicitor General said a medical report found no evidence of torture in the Suresh Sallay case; Sallay's lawyers dispute how the prosecution reads the findings.

items.headline: Bail for monks in Ruwanwelisaya clash
items.summary: Ven. Kassapa Thera, Rajangane Saddharathana Thera and nine others remanded over the Ruwanwelisaya clash were released on bail.

items.headline: Over 100 mm of rain likely in six provinces
items.summary: The Met Department warns of heavy rain above 100 mm in parts of the Western, Sabaragamuwa, Central, North-Central, North-Western and Uva provinces today, with lightning and gusty winds during thunderstorms.

items.headline: Household incomes up, buying power down
items.summary: Provisional census figures show median household income rose to Rs. 75,882 from Rs. 53,333 in 2019, but fell about 39% after inflation, while poverty rose to 16% in early 2025.

items.headline: One year since Cyclone Ditwah
items.summary: A national multi-religious commemoration is being held in Badulla, with PM Harini Amarasuriya attending, for the cyclone that killed more than 650 people and left about 173 missing.

items.headline: President meets unions on Budget
items.summary: President Anura Kumara Dissanayake is due to meet trade union representatives today about Budget 2027. Separately, he urged officials to speed up district development projects.

items.headline: Russian Prosecutor General on first visit
items.summary: Alexander Gutsan began Russia's first-ever working visit by a Prosecutor General. The Justice Minister denied claims that he had been barred from visiting the AG's Department and CIABOC.

items.headline: More jobs in Thailand discussed
items.summary: Thailand's Deputy PM ended his visit after talks on creating more job opportunities for Sri Lankans in Thailand.

items.headline: Envoy warns of fallout from distant wars
items.summary: Sri Lanka's High Commissioner to India said conflicts far from the region can still push up fuel prices and disrupt Indian Ocean shipping.

items.headline: Planters warn over cheap tea imports
items.summary: The Planters' Association says low-cost tea imports could cause the collapse of the plantation economy.

items.headline: IRD warns on cash deals and tax returns
items.summary: The Inland Revenue Department issued two warnings, one on large cash transactions and one on filing tax returns.

items.headline: Rupee slips against the dollar
items.summary: The rupee weakened against the US dollar in today's Central Bank rates.

items.headline: Paying-ward charges raised
items.summary: Room charges in paying wards at state hospitals have gone up.

items.headline: Diana Gamage pleads guilty in visa case
items.summary: Former MP Diana Gamage pleaded guilty to a visa overstay charge at the Colombo Magistrate's Court. Sentencing is set for January 17.

items.headline: Constable in T-56 case brought back from Dubai
items.summary: A police constable accused of handing his T-56 rifle to an organised crime gang was returned from Dubai and arrested.

items.headline: Quazi judge held over bribe; scam director arrested
items.summary: CIABOC arrested a Quazi judge and a woman over an alleged Rs. 65,000 bribe. Police arrested another director in a Rs. 4 billion investment scam.

items.headline: Train rescue hero honoured
items.summary: The Army Commander honoured a Homagama man who crawled under a train to save a trapped female soldier.

items.headline: Cargo ship rescued
items.summary: Sri Lankan authorities rescued a cargo ship carrying about 23,000 tonnes of cargo.

items.headline: Mathews praises Sooryavanshi's 204
items.summary: Angelo Mathews praised Vaibhav Sooryavanshi as a special talent after his 204-run innings.

items.headline: 31 killed in Cairo tanker blaze
items.summary: A fuel tanker crash on a Cairo highway set off a huge fire that killed 31 people and injured 21.
